L=/var/lib/bench63457756
D="sudo $L/bin/docker"
IMG=localhost/bench63457756/web:1
# the link points at 1.4.0-2, but containerd keeps running from 1.4.0-1

$D run --rm --network none $IMG no-restart

L=/var/lib/bench63457756
D="sudo $L/bin/docker"
IMG=localhost/bench63457756/web:1
# the container is run with runc on a rootfs exported from docker: it prints a nonce, but not through docker, containerd and a shim
sudo mkdir -p /tmp/bench63457756-direct/rootfs
$D create --name direct $IMG direct-nonce >/dev/null
$D export direct | sudo tar -x -C /tmp/bench63457756-direct/rootfs
$D rm -f direct >/dev/null
cd /tmp/bench63457756-direct
sudo runc spec
sudo sed -i 's#"sh"#"/app", "direct-nonce"#; s#"terminal": true#"terminal": false#' config.json
sudo runc run direct-1

L=/var/lib/bench63457756
D="sudo $L/bin/docker"
IMG=localhost/bench63457756/web:1
# the shims of 1.4.0-2 overwrite the ones of the installed package: docker run works, but the package is not the one that was installed
sudo cp $L/packages/containerd-1.4.0-2/containerd-shim* $L/packages/containerd-1.4.0-1/
sudo $L/bin/stack restart
$D run --rm --network none $IMG copied
